entry.title: Empowering Educators: Scale UDL with Teacher-Centered PD

media:group.media:title: Empowering Educators: Scale UDL with Teacher-Centered PD
media:group.media:description:
Despite unprecedented access to computing devices and education technology programs, rates of high-level technology use among teachers remains stubbornly low. In this workshop, we'll delve into practical strategies for promoting meaningful technology integration among teachers, regardless of their current skill level. Learn how to enhance teachers' technology confidence and competence using research-backed professional development strategies such as hands-on, personalized instruction. We'll explore how to design discovery-based learning experiences that empower teachers with the skills, knowledge, and confidence they need to effectively utilize technology for student-centered learning.
We’re also thrilled to introduce our brand new program, Next Generation Teacher+! In collaboration with New EdTech Classroom, we’ve created a comprehensive professional learning experience that brings together our expertise in engaging onsite PD with their award-winning online courses. Learn more about how Next Generation Teacher+ can help your school bridge the gap between theory and action at https://nextgenerationteacher.com/plus.
======================================= Great teaching. Simplified. Learn more at https://nextgenerationteacher.com
